bind_host.description: Network interface IP address the collector HTTP server binds to.

bind_port.description: TCP port the collector HTTP server listens on.

queue_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where incoming job results are staged before processing.

max_payload_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) for a single job result payload (e.g., build log).

max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP request handlers (workers).

use_ssl.description: If true, enables HTTPS using the specified certificate and key.

ssl_cert.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (only used if use_ssl is true).

ssl_key.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (only used if use_ssl is true).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging output. Options: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Set to empty string ('') to disable file logging (stdout only).

upstream_collectors.description: List of upstream DebCI collector endpoints to which this collector may forward results.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the upstream collector.

port.description: Port number of the upstream collector's HTTP endpoint.

forward_results.description: If true, automatically forwards completed job results to all configured upstream collectors.

archive_ttl.description: Time (in seconds) after which archived job results are eligible for deletion from the queue directory.

db_uri.description: Database connection URI for metadata storage (e.g., PostgreSQL connection string).

use_db.description: If true, persists job metadata in the configured database instead of using filesystem-only storage.

health_check_interval.description: Minimum interval (in seconds) between internal health checks for collector subsystems.

health_check_path.description: HTTP path exposed for external health check requests (e.g., by Kubernetes liveness probes).
